# 2. Data pre-processing 

Skip if the pre-processing has already been completed.

## 2.1 Peak alignment  
```{r, eval=FALSE, include=T}
datafile <- c("hbnc_a_trim", "hbnc_b_trim", "hbnc_c_trim",
              "hbnn_a_trim", "hbnn_b_trim", "hbnn_c_trim",
              "hbnd_a_trim", "hbnd_b_trim", "hbnd_c_trim",
              "hboc_a_trim", "hboc_b_trim", "hboc_c_trim",
              "hbon_a_trim", "hbon_b_trim", "hbon_c_trim",
              "hbod_a_trim", "hbod_b_trim", "hbod_c_trim"
              )
datafiles <- file.path(dataset_path, datafile)

# Set up the mass tolerance for pre-processing 
ppm <- 30 

# Rotate the sections to make sure all the tissue sections have the same orientation
rotate = c(180, 0, 0,  
           180, 0, 0,
           180, 180, 180,
           180, 180, 0,
           180, 180, 0,
           180, 180, 180)

# Load the peak table and remove peaks that fall below the threshold.
deconv_peaklist <- read.csv(paste0(dataset_path, "/peak_list.csv"))
deconv_peaklist <- deconv_peaklist %>% filter(Intensity >= 5)

combined_imdata_path <- MSI_preprocessing(datafile = datafiles, 
                                          workdir = dataset_path,
                                          deconv_peaklist = deconv_peaklist,
                                          rotate = rotate,
                                          ppm = ppm)
```

## 2.2 Arbitrary Segmentation

This is an example of one run from "HBN control" group. 
```{r, eval=FALSE, include=T}
imdata <- combinedimdata[, which(run(combinedimdata) == "hbnc_a_trim" )]
coordata <- retrieve_coord(imdata)

#Downsample the raw data from 75 µm to 150 µm resolution to improve computational efficiency
coordata$x_conv <-  ((coordata$x-min(coordata$x)) %/% 2) * 2 + min(coordata$x)
coordata$y_conv <-  ((coordata$y-min(coordata$y)) %/% 2) * 2 + min(coordata$y)

df <- unique(data.frame(x = coordata$x_conv,
                 y = coordata$y_conv,
                 run = coordata$run))

# Load segmentation definition
Virtual_segmentation_rankfile <- paste0(dataset_path, "radius_rank_bovin.csv")

# Apply arbitrary segmentation 
df <- virtual_segmentation(df, Virtual_segmentation_rankfile)
colnames(df)[1:2] <- c("x_conv" , "y_conv")
df$pattern <- factor(df$pattern, levels = c("OC", "IC", "Core"))

ggplot(df, aes(x_conv, -y_conv, fill = pattern)) +
            coord_equal()+ylab("y_conv")+
            geom_raster() + labs(fill = "Region") +
            scale_fill_manual(values = c("OC" = "#1b75be", 
                                        "IC" = "#89bff8", 
                                        "Core" = "#e3f1ff")) +
            theme_void()+
            theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
                  axis.title = element_blank(),
                  axis.text = element_blank(),
                  axis.ticks = element_blank(),
                  legend.position = "right")
```

## 2.3 Spectrum calculation

Regional mean spectra from arbitrary segmentation were derived from raw data, with off-tissue areas removed prior to calculation.
```{r, eval=FALSE, include=T}
#Using UMAP to remove the off-tissue areas
sp <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(spectra(imdata, "intensity")))
rownames(sp) <- mz(imdata)
sp_mt <- t(sp)
set.seed(2025)
umap.raw  <-uwot::umap(sp_mt,
                      n_neighbors = 40,
                      metric = "correlation",
                      spread = 1,
                      min_dist = 0.01,
                      n_threads = 47,
                      verbose = TRUE)


umap.res <- as.data.frame(umap.raw)
colnames(umap.res) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

set.seed(2025)
kmeans.res <- kmeans(umap.res[,c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")], centers = 5, nstart = 10)
umap.res$cluster <- as.factor(kmeans.res$cluster)

umap.res <- cbind(umap.res, coordata)

p1 <- ggplot(umap.res, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, color = cluster))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_article()+
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      legend.position = c(0.9, 0.2))+
  scale_color_manual(values = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(5, "Spectral"))

p2 <- ggplot(umap.res, aes(x,y, fill = cluster))+
  geom_raster()+
  theme_article()+ xlim(0, 160)+
  coord_equal()+
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.88, 0.2),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank()
    )+
  scale_fill_manual(values = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(5, "Spectral"))

p3 <- ggplot(umap.res %>% filter(cluster %in% c(1,5)), aes(x,y, fill = cluster))+
  geom_raster(fill = "black")+
  theme_article()+ 
  coord_equal()+
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank()
    )

library(patchwork)
png(paste0(fig_path, "hbnc_a.png"), width = 4200, height = 1500, res = 400)
p1 + p2+ p3 + plot_layout(widths = c(1.2, 1.05, 0.8))
dev.off()
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
umap.res$label <- ifelse(umap.res$cluster %in% c(1, 5),
                         "off tissue",
                         "on tissue")



lt_cluster_mean <- list()

for (cluster in unique(umap.res$label)){
  sp_cluster <- sp[,umap.res$label == cluster]
  df_cluster_mean <- data.frame(mz = rownames(sp_cluster),
                                mean_spec = rowMeans(sp_cluster, na.rm = T),

  lt_cluster_mean[[as.character(cluster)]] <- df_cluster_mean
```

```{r, eval=FALSE, include=T}
# The data will be transformed into a matrix format, with each row corresponding to an m/z value and each column representing a region or pixel. The matrix entries indicate the averaged intensity in that region or the convoluted pixel (150 µm). The "pixel_convolution()" function is used to calculate the regional mean spectra, during which tissue cracks are excluded to avoid bias in the regional averages. However, when computing spectra for convoluted pixels, the cracks are retained to ensure the convolution more accurately reflects the raw data. In this case, off-tissue areas must be removed to prevent background signals from affecting the results.

hbnc_a_region <- pixel_convolution(umap.res,
                                sp,
                                off_tissue_cluster = c(1,5),
                                convolution_level = "region")


hbnc_a_bin <- pixel_convolution(umap.res,
                                sp,
                                off_tissue_cluster = c(1,5),
                                convolution_level = "square_bin")
```

## 3.1 Layer 1 and 2: Bulk analysis and Arbitrary segmentation analysis

### 3.1.1 Bulk anslysis and segmentation analysis
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Imputation
region_df <- log10(mean_sp_df+1)

df_long <- region_df %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("mz") %>%
  pivot_longer(-mz, names_to = "sample", values_to = "intensity") %>%
  mutate(replicate = sub("@.*", "", sample)) 
df_avg <- df_long %>%
  group_by(mz, replicate) %>%
  summarise(mean_intensity = mean(intensity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = replicate, values_from = mean_intensity) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("mz")

hbnc_cols <- c("hbnc_a_trim", "hbnc_b_trim", "hbnc_c_trim")
hboc_cols <- c("hboc_a_trim", "hboc_b_trim", "hboc_c_trim")


df_avg_select <- df_avg %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(c(hbnc_cols, hboc_cols)))

df_avg_select$mz <- rownames(df_avg_select)
df_long <- df_avg_select %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(c(hbnc_cols, hboc_cols)),
               names_to = "replicate",
               values_to = "intensity") %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      str_detect(replicate, "hbnc") ~ "hbnc",
      str_detect(replicate, "hboc") ~ "hboc"
    )
  ) %>% filter(mz %in% mz_names)

df_long$name <- names(mz_names)[match(df_long$mz, mz_names)]
df_long$Region <- "Whole lens"
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df_long_r <- region_df %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("mz") %>%
  pivot_longer(-mz, names_to = "sample", values_to = "intensity") %>%
  filter(mz %in% mz_names) %>% 
  separate(sample, into = c("id_part", "Region"), sep = "@", remove = FALSE) %>%
  separate(id_part, into = c("group", "replicate"), sep = "_", extra = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::select(mz, intensity, group, Region, replicate)%>% 
  filter(group %in% c("hbnc", "hboc") )


df_long_r$name <- names(mz_names)[match(df_long_r$mz, mz_names)]

df_long_all <- rbind(df_long, df_long_r)
df_long_all$Region <- factor(df_long_all$Region, levels = c("Whole lens", "OC", "IC", "Core"))
# 
png(paste0(fig_path, "whole_lens_comparison_seg.png"), width = 2700, height = 3300, res = 500)

p_bar <- ggplot(df_long_all %>% 
         filter(name %in%  c("GSH", "CySSG", "Cysteine")) %>%
         mutate(name = factor(name, 
                              levels = c("GSH", 
                                         "CySSG", 
                                         "Cysteine"))), 
       aes(x = group, y = intensity)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, 
               geom = "bar", 
               aes(fill = group), 
               alpha = 0.45, 
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
```

### 3.1.2 Volcano plot by region 
```{r, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Baseline comparison
my_comparisons <- list(c("hbnc","hboc"))
param <- SnowParam(workers = 2,  progressbar = F)
comparison_res <- bplapply(rownames(mean_sp_df), 
                           function(mz) {
  compare_groups_stats(mean_sp_df, mz, my_comparisons)
}, BPPARAM = param)

comparison_res_df <- do.call(rbind, comparison_res)
comparison_res_df$region <- factor(comparison_res_df$region, 
                                   levels = c("OC", "IC", "Core"))
comparison_res_df$Label <- names(mz_names)[match(comparison_res_df$m.z, mz_names)] 

filtered_df <- comparison_res_df %>%
  filter(is.finite(log2FC), is.finite(-log10(p_value)))
filtered_df <- comparison_res_df %>%
  filter(is.finite(log2FC), is.finite(-log10(p_value))) %>%
  mutate(Significance = ifelse(abs(log2FC) > 0.5 & p_value < 0.05, "Sig", "Non-sig"),
         change = case_when(
      log2FC > 0.5 & p_value < 0.05 ~ "Increased",
      log2FC < -0.5 & p_value < 0.05 ~ "Decreased",
      TRUE ~ "Not Sig"
    ),
    size_plot = ifelse(change == "Not Sig", 0.5, -log10(p_value))
         )
```

```{r, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}
png(paste0(fig_path, "volcano_plot_hbnc_hboc.png"), width = 2500, height = 2000, res = 400)
p_vol <- ggplot() +
  geom_jitter(data = filtered_df %>% 
                filter(change == "Not Sig"), 
              aes(x = region,
                  y = log2FC,
                  color = change), 
              size = 0.6,
              alpha = 0.3, 
              position = position_jitter(width = 0.3)) +
  geom_jitter(data = filtered_df %>% 
                filter(!change == "Not Sig", is.na(Label) == T),
              aes(x = region,
                  y = log2FC,

                  color = change),
              alpha = 0.35, 
              position = position_jitter(width = 0.3)) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = filtered_df %>%

        y = log2FC,

  ) +
```

### 3.1.3 Heatmap by region
Prepare Heatmap data
```{r, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}
# Filter target molecules
region_filter <- region_df[which(as.numeric(rownames(region_df)) %in% mz_names),]
rownames(region_filter) <- names(mz_names)[match(as.numeric(rownames(region_filter)), mz_names)]
region_filter[region_filter <= 0] <- 0
region_filter_mt <- as.matrix(region_filter)

OC_cols   <- grep("@OC$", colnames(region_filter_mt), value = TRUE)
IC_cols   <- grep("@IC$", colnames(region_filter_mt), value = TRUE)
Core_cols <- grep("@Core$", colnames(region_filter_mt), value = TRUE)

log_OC   <- region_filter_mt[, OC_cols]
log_IC   <- region_filter_mt[, IC_cols]
log_Core <- region_filter_mt[, Core_cols]

log_OC <- log_OC %>% as.data.frame() %>%
                 select(matches("hbnc|hboc")) %>% as.matrix()
log_IC <- log_IC %>% as.data.frame() %>%
                 select(matches("hbnc|hboc")) %>% as.matrix()
log_Core <- log_Core %>% as.data.frame() %>%
                 select(matches("hbnc|hboc")) %>% as.matrix()
```

Heatmap Parameters
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(0,1,2,3,5), c("#69AADB", "#cae5f8", "#FAEFF5","#F2C5DA", "#D45590"))

cell_fun <- function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
  grid.roundrect(
    x, y,
    width  = w * 0.92,
    height = h * 0.92,
    r = unit(0.35, "snpc"),
    gp = gpar(fill = fill, col = NA)
  )
}

sample_OC <- sub("_.*", "", colnames(log_OC))
sample_IC <- sub("_.*", "", colnames(log_IC))
sample_Core <- sub("_.*", "", colnames(log_Core))

group_colors <- c("hbnc" = "#6A9BCB", "hboc" = "#CB5148")

col_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = sample_OC,
  col = list(Group = group_colors),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 0, col = NA)  
)

```

Draw Heatmap
```{r, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}
ht_OC <- Heatmap(
    log_OC,
    name = "Relative Intensity",
    col = col_fun,
    column_title = "OC",
    top_annotation = col_anno,
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,

    show_row_dend = FALSE,
    rect_gp = gpar(col =NA, fill =NA),
    cell_fun = cell_fun,   
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
        at = c(min(log_OC, na.rm = TRUE), max(log_OC, na.rm = TRUE)),
        labels = c("Min", "Max")
    )
)


ht_IC <- Heatmap(

        at = c(min(log_OC, na.rm = TRUE), max(log_OC, na.rm = TRUE)),
        labels = c("Min", "Max")
    )
)


ht_Core <- Heatmap(
    log_Core,
```

### 3.2.6 FC map
```{r, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
HexBin_FC <- load_csv(paste0(dataset_path, "/HexBin_FC_baseline_comparison.csv"))
hexbin_df_all <- load_csv(paste0(dataset_path, "/hexbin_df_all.csv"))

info <- as.data.frame(str_split_fixed(colnames(hexbin_df_all), "@", 2))
colnames(info) <- c("run", "bin")
info$treatment <- sub("_.*", "", info$run)
```


```{r, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
group1 = "hbnc"
group2 = "hboc"

pval_list <- list()

for (bin in unique(info$bin)){
  idx1 <- '&'(info$treatment == group1, info$bin == bin)
  idx2 <- '&'(info$treatment == group2, info$bin == bin)
  
  if (sum(idx1)> 1 && sum(idx2) > 1) {
    df1 <- hexbin_df_all[,idx1]
    df2 <- hexbin_df_all[,idx2]
    pvals <- apply(df1, 1, function(x, y) t.test(x, y)$p.value, y = df2)
  } else {
    pvals <- rep(NA, nrow(df1))
    names(pvals) <- rownames(df1)
  }
  
  pval_list[[as.character(bin)]] <- pvals
}

final_pvals <- as.data.frame(pval_list)
rownames(final_pvals) <- rownames(df1)
colnames(final_pvals) <- sub("^X", "", colnames(final_pvals))
```

### 3.3.2 Bulk anslysis and segmentation analysis

```{r, eval=FALSE, message=FALSE}
my_comparisons <- list(c("hbnc","hboc"),
                       c("hbnc","hbon") )

param <- SnowParam(workers =2,  progressbar = TRUE)
comparison_res <- bplapply(rownames(mean_sp_df), function(mz) {
  compare_groups_stats(mean_sp_df, mz, my_comparisons)
}, BPPARAM = param)
comparison_res_df <- do.call(rbind, comparison_res)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
comparison_res_df <- comparison_res_df %>% 
  mutate(comparison =  paste0(group2, "_vs_", group1))

df_wide <- comparison_res_df %>%
  select(m.z, region, comparison, log2FC, p_value) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = comparison,
    values_from = c(log2FC, p_value)
  )

df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  mutate(
    sig1 = abs(log2FC_hboc_vs_hbnc) > 0.5 & p_value_hboc_vs_hbnc < 0.05,
    sig2 = abs(log2FC_hbon_vs_hbnc) > 0.5 & p_value_hbon_vs_hbnc < 0.05,
    sig_status = case_when(
      sig1 & sig2 ~ "Both Significant",
      sig1 & !sig2 ~ "Only hbnc vs hboc",
      !sig1 & sig2 ~ "Only hbnc vs hbon",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    )
  )

df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  mutate(
    alpha_status = case_when(
      sig_status %in% c("Only hbnc vs hboc", "Only hbnc vs hbon") ~ 0.9,
      TRUE ~ 0.3
    )
  )

df_wide$region <- factor(df_wide$region, levels = c("OC", "IC", "Core"))
df_wide$sig_status <- factor(df_wide$sig_status, levels = c("Not Significant", "Both Significant", "Only hbnc vs hboc",
"Only hbnc vs hbon"))

label_df <- df_wide[df_wide$m.z %in% mz_names, ]
label_df$label <- names(mz_names)[match(label_df$m.z, mz_names)]

# png(paste0(fig_path, "hbnc_hboc_hbon_fc_plot_3_rep.png") , width = 6000, height = 2500, res = 550)
ggplot(df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  filter(!if_any(everything(), ~ is.infinite(.))), 
       aes(x = log2FC_hboc_vs_hbnc, y = log2FC_hbon_vs_hbnc)) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(region)) +
  theme_article()+
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_blank())+
  xlim(-10,10)+
  ylim(-10,10)+
  coord_equal()+
  labs(x = expression("HBOc vs HBNc (log"[2]*"[FC])"),
       y = expression("HBOn vs HBNc (log"[2]*"[FC])"))+
  geom_point(aes(color = sig_status), alpha = 0.7, size = 2)+
  geom_point(data = label_df %>% filter(!sig_status == "Not Significant"),
             aes(fill = sig_status),
             shape = 21, 
             color = "black",
             alpha = 1,
             size = 2.5,
             stroke = 0.6, 
             show.legend = FALSE)+
  
    scale_fill_manual(
        values = c(
            "Not Significant" = "grey80",
            "Only hbnc vs hboc" = "#377bab", 
            "Only hbnc vs hbon" = "#7d3d92",
            "Both Significant" = "#ccb4d7" 
        )) +
  scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
            "Not Significant" = "grey80",
            "Only hbnc vs hboc" = "#377bab", 
            "Only hbnc vs hbon" = "#7d3d92",
            "Both Significant" = "#ccb4d7" 
        )) +
   geom_hline(yintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.7) + 
  geom_text_repel(data = label_df %>% filter(!sig_status == "Not Significant"),
                  aes(label = label),
                  size = 3,
                  force = 2,
                  # fontface = "bold",
                  max.overlaps = 20,
                  box.padding = 1,  
                  segment.color = "black",    
                  segment.size = 0.5
                  ) 
# dev.off()
```

```{r, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
region_filter_long <- region_filter %>%
```

```{r, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}
    axis.text  = element_blank(),  
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    )
dev.off()

```
